youtube_description:
Her Excellency Danish Ambassador to the Philippines Grete Sillasen speaking to THEPHILBIZNEWS during the Nordic Ambassadors Forum on Ambassadors’ Forum on Smart and Sustainable Cities late last year told that the Philippines like Denmark can achieve the  Smart City Philippines.

Find out more how the Philippines can achieve this Smart and Sustainable Cities by watching the video.
